title: Comparison calculus for native supported cup operations
statement: For the finite datum of [def-pur-conventions] and native operations of [def-pur-supported-cup-functoriality-models], canonical etale-to-pro-etale comparison is bijective on supported, ordinary and open Hom classes; commutes with their pullback maps; preserves the prescribed cup and Kummer classes; and respects forget-support, open restriction and the actual localization boundary. These are exactly the eleven fields of FunctorialCupComparisonLaws.

source.place: Tag 0FPM, lemma-cup-product-commutative (and Tag 0FPL, associativity); supported refinement formulated by the agent from the tensor-morphism construction in def-pur-supported-cup, Stacks Tag 09XP localization, Tag 03PL Kummer sequence, and Tag 0G78 supported functoriality (cohomology.tex). Pro-etale comparison compatibility is part of this auxiliary statement, not an assertion that 0FPM alone states it.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-supported-cup-comparison-basic] for the three comparison bijections and the forget-support and open-restriction equations. Apply [lem-pur-supported-cup-comparison-coherence] for the remaining six equations. Assemble the eleven fields.
